sub: Becoming Magnificent is perfectly positioned for paid advertising to the Bookfunnels model. The existing AI-generated book site is a solid foundation but lacks the infrastructure to increase order value enough to make advertising financially viable and sustainable. Bookfunnels.io provides the infrastructure to capture readers, increase order value, and ascend into backend programs.

markers.text: Break-even: $52 benchmark AOV against an estimated $40 CPA. The ad acquisition cost is paid for before the reader logs in to download the book.
